label: Subscription Revenue
definition: Revenue from subscription-based services and recurring contracts.
reason: Material revenue stream component, clearly distinct product line

label: Hardware Revenue
definition: Revenue from sales of physical hardware products.
reason: Material revenue stream component, distinct product line

label: Service Revenue
definition: Revenue from professional services and non-subscription service offerings.
reason: Material revenue stream component, distinct from subscription and hardware

label: Sales Discounts and Allowances
definition: Contra-revenue account for discounts, returns, and allowances granted to customers.
reason: Material contra-revenue item that reduces total revenue

label: Corporate and Personnel Costs
definition: Employee compensation, benefits, and corporate overhead costs.
reason: Material operating expense category for personnel-related costs

label: General and Administrative
definition: General administrative expenses not classified elsewhere.
reason: Material G&A expense component distinct from other categories

label: Occupancy Costs
definition: Rent, utilities, and other facility-related operating expenses.
reason: Material operating expense for facilities and real estate

label: Software Expense
definition: Operating expenses for software licenses, subscriptions, and SaaS tools.
reason: Material operating expense category for software and technology costs

label: Sales and Marketing
definition: Expenses for sales activities, marketing campaigns, and customer acquisition.
reason: Material operating expense category for revenue generation activities

label: Prepaid Expenses
definition: Payments made in advance for goods or services to be received in future periods.
reason: Material current asset category for prepaid items

label: Other Current Assets
definition: Current assets not classified in other specific categories.
reason: Material current asset category for miscellaneous items

label: Accumulated Depreciation
definition: Cumulative depreciation on property, plant, and equipment.
reason: Material contra-asset for PP&E valuation

label: Credit Card Payable
definition: Outstanding balances on corporate credit cards.
reason: Material current liability for credit card obligations

label: Accrued Expenses
definition: Expenses incurred but not yet paid as of the balance sheet date.
reason: Material current liability for accrued obligations

label: Operating Lease Liability, Noncurrent
definition: Long-term portion of operating lease obligations due beyond one year.
reason: Material long-term liability for lease obligations

label: Change in Prepaid Expenses
definition: Change in prepaid expenses and other current assets as a working capital adjustment in operating cash flow.
formula_expression: component of operating cash flow working capital changes
reason: Material working capital line item that adjusts net income to operating cash flow

label: Change in Other Assets
definition: Change in other non-current or miscellaneous assets as an operating cash flow adjustment.
formula_expression: component of operating cash flow working capital changes
reason: Working capital adjustment line item in operating activities

label: Change in Accounts Payable
definition: Change in accounts payable as a working capital adjustment in operating cash flow.
formula_expression: component of operating cash flow working capital changes
reason: Key working capital line item showing supplier payment timing impact on cash

label: Change in Credit Cards Payable
definition: Change in credit card liabilities as a working capital adjustment in operating cash flow.
formula_expression: component of operating cash flow working capital changes
reason: Material working capital line for companies using corporate credit cards

label: Change in Deferred Revenue
definition: Change in deferred revenue as a working capital adjustment in operating cash flow.
formula_expression: component of operating cash flow working capital changes
reason: Critical working capital line for subscription/SaaS business showing cash collected in advance

label: Change in Other Current Liabilities
definition: Change in other current liabilities as a working capital adjustment in operating cash flow.
formula_expression: component of operating cash flow working capital changes
reason: Working capital adjustment for miscellaneous short-term obligations

label: Change in Long-Term Lease
definition: Cash impact from changes in long-term lease obligations or right-of-use assets in investing activities.
reason: Lease-related investing activity, material for companies with significant lease commitments

label: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Debt
definition: Cash proceeds from issuing convertible debt instruments.
reason: Material financing activity for growth companies raising capital via convertible notes

label: Proceeds from (Payments on) PWB Line of Credit
definition: Net cash from draws and repayments on the PWB revolving credit facility.
reason: Specific credit line activity, material for understanding debt financing

label: Proceeds from PPP Loan
definition: Cash proceeds from Paycheck Protection Program loan.
reason: Material government loan program proceeds during COVID period

label: Proceeds from Issuance of Capital Stock
definition: Cash proceeds from issuing common or preferred stock.
reason: Material equity financing activity for growth companies
